newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers edge up on crude, good demand.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers edge up on crude, good demand.

text.p: Singapore bunker indications on Friday were a shade higher in line with crude gains and more enquiries, traders said.
Shipowners who were previously sidelined by the high offers have returned to cover their requirements, traders said. "They have no choice as some ships have to sail," said a major.
The major said he sold a parcel of bunker 180-cst at $129.50 per tonne, and 380-cst was quoted at $124 per tonne, a dollar higher from Thursday's quotes.
MDO and gasoil were steady at $222-$226 and $235-$240 respectively. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870-3082)
